changelog: 0.2.0.0: Bug-fix release. Ratings no longer re-sent on every progress save; throttle dict leaks fixed; ItemAdded is now deferred until provider IDs land; 10s HTTP timeout. MediaShelfClient is now DI-registered. 24 xUnit tests added. See GitHub release notes for details.
description: Syncs your Jellyfin library, watch history, ratings, and playback progress to a MediaShelf instance.
name: MediaShelf Sync
overview: Syncs your library, watch history, ratings, and playback progress to MediaShelf.
